thread:
lee: Quick heads up from onboarding QA: payments sampleapp produced duplicate charges when our CI forced token refresh + API returned intermittent 429s. Repro attached.
ana: Yikes. Can you paste the minimal repro?
lee: Repro steps (CI-run): 1) run sampleapp test with short token TTL 2) induce a 429 on the first attempt 3) SDK retries -> two successful 200 responses recorded by backend within 1s. Logs: 
```
[2026-03-16T10:12:34Z] WARN tx=9c1b 429 retry_after=0.3s attempt=1
[2026-03-16T10:12:35Z] INFO tx=9c1b retry attempt=2 got 200 -> charge=ch_live_abc
[2026-03-16T10:12:35Z] INFO tx=9c1b processed -> charge=ch_live_def
```
ron: Looks like the client is generating a new request_id per try. Server dedupe uses header Idempotency-Key or request_id body field. If body-level request_id changes on retry, server treats as new.
nana: Right. Sampleapp currently does: 
```js
// naive sampleapp flow
const payload = {amount, currency, request_id: uuid()}
await sdk.post('/v1/charges', payload)
```
So uuid() runs on each fresh request.
lee: The SDK backoff is also a problem. Current defaults: base=200ms, cap=2s, exponential without jitter. With token refresh jitter is needed; retries bunch up and both slip through after rotation.
ron: Proposed fixes: (1) Sampleapp: persist a single client-generated request_id per logical operation and reuse across retries. (2) SDK: optionally set Idempotency-Key header automatically for mutating endpoints, with opt-out flag. (3) SDK: switch default to full jitter exponential backoff: delay = random(0, base * 2^attempt), set base=400ms. (4) Server: enforce a short dedupe TTL (safeReplayWindowMs) configurable per route.
ci-bot: CI job #789 payments-integ showed 3/50 runs with duplicate charge detection.
nana: I like that plan. A few compliance/security notes before auto-header defaults: some customers route headers to logs, and Idempotency-Key values may contain PII if apps misuse them. SDK should sanitize and docs must call out retention/telemetry. Also Enterprise should be able to disable via config.
lee: Agreed. For immediate unblock I'll patch the sampleapp to stash a request_id in the retry context: 
```js
const requestId = uuid()
await retry(async () => sdk.post('/v1/charges', {amount, request_id: requestId}))
```
That stops duplicates in the short term.
ron: For the SDK PR I propose defaults: autoIdempotency=true, autoIdempotencyOptOutEnv=REDWOOD_SDK_AUTOIDEMPOTENCY=false, backoff.strategy=full_jitter, backoff.base_ms=400. Add telemetry event when SDK auto-injects header (anonymized boolean). Tag security for retention policy.
lee: Any thoughts on rollout? Canary the SDK in sampleapp first, run the CI harness with forced token rotation. If we see remaining dupes, increase base_ms or adjust safeReplayWindowMs.
ci-bot: Canary deploy of sdk@canary-20260316 started for sampleapp.
nana: I'll file a short doc blurb in onboarding about the token-rotation + 429 edge and link to the sampleapp PR. Also add a checklist item: "ensure request id stable across retries".
ron: One more: add an e2e test that simulates short token TTL and returns 429 once, assert backend sees at most one charge per logical request id. Lee, can you add that?
lee: Yup I'll add the e2e and the sampleapp patch. Opening PRs now and linking this thread.
nana: Thanks — great catch. This was a sneaky DX gotcha for new customers trying the example payment flow.
